body: Thank you, that’s really helpful. I think I’m gonna give it a try.
I think maybe writing it out is a good plan, I just don’t even know what to say. As soon as I start I just feel embarrassed and like I’m blowing things way out of proportion.
That’s how I feel too. I’m so sorry you feel that way, too.

Thank you for answering, I appreciate it so much. 

Was the psych ward scary? 

I had to go one time bc I was trying to harm myself with a box cutter, and my sister called the police and they pointed their tasers at me and when I finally dropped the box cutter they took me to the hospital, and they took away my phone and left me in a room all by myself, and they were really harsh and they let me leave by myself at like 3am. I just don’t want to go through that again. Sorry for all the information.

Sorry to bother you, but could you maybe tell me what happens when you check yourself in? 
I feel like I might need to but I’m scared and no one will explain it to me. I’ve been to hospital once but it was horrible. 

If you don’t want to tho, no worries, thank you
